messages:
sam_sales: Quick sync Connex asked for a short POC: Okta SSO (SP-initiated) + SCIM group sync -> RBAC mapping, plus answers on Dedicated pricing and domain verification. They want a 1hr session next Tue morning.

li_se: I can own the POC. Need clarity: expected users/groups for the test, cert rotation frequency, and SCIM delta SLA target. Also, do they want role precedence rules?

connex_okta_admin: We'll bring a test Okta org. ~800 users, ~320 groups initially. Cert rotation quarterly. Need SCIM delta under ~3 minutes for provisioning. Role precedence: prefer explicit mapping, fallback to least privilege.

nina_sec: Security prelim: Hosted supports TLS + AES-256 at rest and we can offer BYOK for Hosted via customer KMS. Dedicated supports HSM. We'll need them to fill the vendor questionnaire before enabling BYOK; also ask about EU residency requirements.

alex_prod: Product notes: SCIM supports incremental sync and cursor paging (good for >1k groups). Default SCIM throttle 5rps on Hosted; configurable on Dedicated. We support group->role mapping and conflict resolution strategies (highest/least privilege). Domain verification via DNS TXT or email token.

tessa_legal: Legal: request their legal contact. I'll prepare DPA + SOC2 Type II and confirm deletion SLA requirements. If they need EU-data-residency in Dedicated, contracts will reflect that.

li_se: POC runbook (short): 1) Exchange SP metadata + ACS URL 2) Issue scoped SCIM token 3) Upload mapping file 4) Run initial sync (200 users) then delta tests 5) Validate audit logs + rotation test. I'll put a runbook in #eng-sre.

sam_sales: Pricing Q: Connex asks "approx delta for Dedicated at ~100M tokens/mo" any quick ballpark?

alex_prod: Ballpark: Hosted consumption ~ $0.0008/token -> ~$80k/mo. Dedicated adds infra/ops premium; rough delta +$20-40k/mo depending on replication and commit. Finance to confirm. For POC we can reserve capacity for 10 days.

deploy-bot: Note: Maintenance Tue 07:45 PT no expected customer impact.

sam_sales: OK locking Tue 10am PT. Li will send invite and runbook. Nina/Tessa please share docs before then. Connex Okta admin will send SP metadata.

connex_okta_admin: Confirmed I'll send SP metadata and a test admin account by EOD Mon.

li_se: Got it I'll add rollback steps (fallback to Hosted) and include SCIM test harness.
